quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Clippers' turnover issues against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: you turn the ball over 22 times against this team, the way they play, it makes it tough
quotes.quote: Turnovers led to easy baskets for them in transition. You turn the ball over 22 times against this team, the way they play, the athletes, the way they push the ball, it makes it tough on you. We knew coming into the game we had to take care of the basketball. I thought we did a good job of guarding the half court, but when they got out in transition and we turned the basketball over, it was hard to keep them under control.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers turnover issues were the difference against the Spurs tonight. They gave up 22 turnovers and struggled to contain the transition game.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the team's turnover issues during the postgame press conference following the game against the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Giannis Antetokounmpo's return from injury
quotes.excerpt: he's the pulse of our team and the heartbeat of our team
quotes.quote: Just a little rusty, fumbled a couple balls. When you are out for that long of a period, the speed of the game is different. It was great to have him back. Him getting used to it, getting in better shape, understanding timing and things like that, it is going to take some time for him to get back to himself and we understand that. Giannis Antetokounmpo is the pulse of our team and the heartbeat of our team.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says Giannis Antetokounmpo looked a little rusty in his return but remains the pulse and heartbeat of the team. Lue notes it will take some time for him to get back to himself.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue reacts to Giannis Antetokounmpo returning to the court after an injury absence.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the impact of Max Christie in the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: the way he moves without the basketball and just his pace and creating action makes us a different team
quotes.quote: Creating action. I think Max Christie in that starting lineup, the way he moves without the basketball and just his pace and creating action, makes us a different team. Kobe Bryant didn't do nothing wrong, he's the pulse of our team and the heartbeat of our team. So just looking at some different things, I thought Max was great tonight. We understood the offensive game plan, we did the right thing.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Boston Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Boston Jr. on his return to the court after 260 days
quotes.excerpt: it's my first game back after 260 days and I was just hyped to be back playing
quotes.quote: It's my first game back after 260 days and I was just hyped to be back playing. It's going to take time to get adjusted back to the game speed, playing with the guys. quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabaté
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabaté on the Clippers' defensive strategy against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: the game plan was to get Victor Wembanyama to the outside, so that part of the middle was open
quotes.quote: The game plan was to get Victor Wembanyama to the outside, so that part of the middle was open. That was what we were looking for. The opponent also played with a lot of physicality, so that is where I got caught at the end. We are a young team, so we are going to get better from this. I think we have a good season ahead.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: その試合のゲームプランは、ビクター・ウェンバンヤマを外に引き出すことだったので、その分中がすごく空いていたので、そこを狙っていったんですけども。相手もフィジカルでしっかりやってきたので、そこで僕らも最後の最後でかさられたかなと思います。チームは若いチームなので、そこから上がっていくと思うので、これからが楽しみだなと思います。
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate explains the Clippers defensive strategy against Victor Wembanyama was to force him to the outside. He admits the team got caught by the physicality of the Spurs late in the game.

structured.context: Moussa Diabaté describes the defensive game plan used by the Clippers to contain Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabaté
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabaté on the Clippers' offensive execution and pace
quotes.excerpt: we did exactly what we were supposed to do tonight and we gave ourselves a chance
quotes.quote: We did exactly what we were supposed to do tonight and we gave ourselves a chance. You know how the Spurs are, they are a championship team, they are a final team for a reason. They got a lead, but we talked about we got to keep playing like this. We got a good start and we finished the first half and we came out with a good second half too. So we got to keep doing this and we are going to get more wins.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate says the Clippers executed their game plan well against the Spurs and believes the team is on the right track despite the result.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabaté
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabaté on his comfort playing a 3-and-D role
quotes.excerpt: when I'm playing 3-and-D, that's what I'm best at
quotes.quote: Just trying to play free. I talked to the coaches a little bit. I think that's the one I'm good at. When I'm playing 3-and-D, that's what I'm best at. Playing with these guys, I got to start getting used to it. They know where exactly I want the ball to be. The timing and all that, it's all going to start clicking. It's just an early, early season, but I think we have a good season ahead.
